facets.name: LLM systems
facets.about: Building with LLMs in production. Inference and serving, agents, memory, retrieval and RAG, evals, fine-tuning, tokenizers.

facets.name: ML from first principles
facets.about: How neural networks and transformers actually work. Backprop, optimisation, attention, scaling, built up from scratch.

facets.name: Systems and design
facets.about: Distributed systems, databases and storage engines, consensus, caching, queues, performance work, real stories of scale and outages.

facets.name: CS core
facets.about: Algorithms and data structures, operating systems, compilers, networking, computer architecture, low-level programming.

facets.name: Offensive security
facets.about: Exploitation, reverse engineering, red teaming, AI and LLM security, the best conference talks (DEF CON, CCC, Black Hat).

facets.name: History
facets.about: History of computing and engineering, and world history told well. Documentaries, lectures, narrative history.

facets.name: Explainer craft
facets.about: Exceptionally well-made explanations. Visual or animated, great storytelling. Reference for making our own explainer videos.

facets.name: Building companies
facets.about: Technical founders, bootstrapping, selling to technical buyers, hard lessons from building products.
